plain: A gift of money or goods, often to a cause

webster.text: The act of giving or bestowing; a grant.

example.quote: An increase of his salary, or some donation, was always made a condition; till at last it became the regular practice, to have orders in his favor on the Treasury, presented along with the bills to be signed, so that he might actually receive the former before he should sign the latter.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, June 4, 1787
